claims.statement: data/jobs.json is the canonical public discovery feed; catalog maintenance preserves existing application status, validates canonical employer URLs and disclosed dates, records source freshness, and deduplicates roles.
Discover defaults to the latest discovery date, hides roles already opened into the tracker, supports day/type/text filtering, and renders full-time roles before internships.
Opening a posting adds browser tracking but is separate from applying, while queueing creates preparation state without submitting an application.
Owned agent batches keep personal recommendations separate from shared employer records and require authentication of the owner; a batch identifier alone is not access authority.

Application timelines distinguish milestones and user-reported activity from observed submission confirmation, validate dates without inventing them, and order dated evidence separately from undated process stages.

Applications combines browser tracker IDs with private workflow application IDs, gives workflow state precedence, and presents separate full-time and internship counters with Active, Saved jobs and Closed views plus stage filters.
An owned application can be explicitly linked to a company workspace while retaining its own status and submission evidence.
